Start from the question your figure should answer, not from a chart name.
Each page below opens with curated, real-data showcases that follow data visualisation best practices, followed by focused feature demos.
The **By feature** pages cover the finishing work that turns a correct chart into a clear one: annotation, colour, guides, layout, and theming.
Every example lives in the [`examples/`](https://github.com/mcanouil/gribouille/tree/main/examples) directory of the repository, and its source can be copied from the page.

The gallery replaces the single `/examples/` page, which is now an alias for this hub.
The per-example anchors of that page are gone.
To find an example again, open the intent page that matches it.

::: {#gallery}
